REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - AUGUST 26, 2021 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021), this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

This section is reserved for comments related to the Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and/or items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the legislative body, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a legislative body member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

11.
Reports
11A.
Report from City Manager/Executive Director
During this part of the meeting the City Manager/Executive Director or designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior City Council meeting, including any request by the City Council to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior City Council meeting's agenda.
11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.

After the City Council/Successor Agency reconvenes into Open Session, designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken in Closed Session. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
13.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
AUGUST 26, 2021, 7:00 P.M., IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL,
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Jeff Ludington, Generations Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cub Scout Pack 529 (Webelos).

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

  MOTION TO EXCUSE: It was moved by Barrows, seconded by Hu, to excuse Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair Vo from the Thursday, August 26, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor
  Agency Regular Meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 – 0 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  None.

5B.  Informational update on the City's response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager.
  A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to place the video memorializing
  the first anniversary of September 11th on the City’s website if available in the City’s
  archive.

(minutes continue on the next page)

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  Cornelis van der Linden submitted written correspondence regarding a proposed plan for
  a second water supply for residents.

  In-person public comments:

  Case van der Linden spoke regarding a proposed plan for a second water supply for
  residents.

  Saurabh Deedwania requested signage at City parks to remind those riding bikes or
  scooters to be mindful of pedestrians on the walkways.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, August 12, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Thursday,
  August 12, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 – 0 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

  Thursday, August 12, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Thursday,
  August 12, 2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 – 0 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, August 26, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 7

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated August 26, 2021 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register
  of Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  August 26, 2021  $ 10,251,605.52 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (4 – 0 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of a request by CalMet Services for an adjustment to the
  maximum allowable solid waste management rates (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Environmental Services Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  Bill Kalpakoff, representing CalMet Services, spoke in support of their request and
  responded to inquiries from the City Council.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Written correspondence:
  (Written correspondence is considered public record and full-text copies of submitted
  written correspondence can be obtained in the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer)

  The following individuals submitted written correspondence in support of the request by
  CalMet Services for an adjustment to the maximum allowable solid waste management
  rates:

  Sue Carter

  The following individuals submitted written correspondence in opposition to the request
  by CalMet Services for an adjustment to the maximum allowable solid waste
  management rates:

  Beverly F. Porter
  Lana Lauderdale
  Evelyn Chang
  Norma Williamson
  La Vivian Taylor
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, August 26, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  In-person public comments:

  Mel Cortez spoke in opposition to the request by CalMet Services for an adjustment to
  the maximum allowable solid waste management rates.

  Case van der Linden spoke in opposition to the request by CalMet Services for an
  adjustment to the maximum allowable solid waste management rates.

  Jennifer Hong spoke in opposition to the request by CalMet Services for an adjustment
  to the maximum allowable solid waste management rates.

  Ernie Nishii spoke in opposition to the request by CalMet Services for an adjustment to
  the maximum allowable solid waste management rates.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION (DID NOT PASS): It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Barrows, to
  approve CalMet Services’ revised request to adjust the maximum allowable solid waste
  management rates in Cerritos by the following amounts effective September 1, 2021:

  Residential  2.0% increase
  Commercial Bin:  0.6% increase
  Commercial Roll-Off:  0.1% decrease
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion did not pass (2 – 2 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki
  NOES:  Yokoyama, Hu
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Attorney confirmed this item could be brought up for reconsideration in
  accordance with the City Council’s Protocol Manual.

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, August 26, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of the 2021-22 Mayor’s annual appointment recommendations
  for resident and community member service on external committees (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Yokoyama, to defer review and
  consideration of the 2021-22 Mayor’s annual appointment recommendations for resident
  and community member service on external committees to the Monday, September 13,
  2021, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of City of Cerritos Official Councilmember voting delegates to
  the 89th Annual meeting of the United States Conference of Mayors to be held August 31
  through September 4, 2021 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk Treasurer.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1.  Affirm Mayor Grace Hu to serve as the City’s Official Voting Delegate to cast the
  City’s one (1) vote at the 2021 United States Conference of Mayors Annual
  Meeting/Business Session; and

  2.  Affirm Mayor Pro Tem Vo to serve as the City’s Official Voting Alternate at the 2021
  United States Conference of Mayors Annual Meeting/Business Session with the
  understanding that the Voting Alternate is authorized to cast the City’s one (1) vote
  in the Mayor’s absence and cannot have the floor to speak to any issue under
  discussion; and

  3.  Direct City Staff to transmit the Official Voting Delegate and Alternate designations
  in writing to the appropriate contact for the 2021 United States Conference of
  Mayors Annual Meeting and Business Session and coordinate with the designees the
  final method by which the Official Voting Credential will be issued; and

  4.  Direct staff to add the designation of the Mayor as the City’s Official Voting Delegate
  and the Mayor Pro Tem or other City Councilmember designee as the City’s Official
  Voting Alternate to the United States Conference of Mayors to the Mayor’s Annual
  Appointments List which is reviewed and considered by the City Council each year
  after the annual Mayoral rotation; and
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, August 26, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 6 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  5.  Direct staff to annually place an agenda report closer to the actual United States
  Conference of Mayors Annual Meeting registration deadline for the City Council to
  review and consider whether adjustments to the assigned Voting Delegate or Voting
  Alternate should be made in the event the designees have scheduling conflicts
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (4 – 0 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Vo (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  A report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager, on the status of
  Senate Bill 9 related to housing development approvals and noted the City’s
  opposition to the proposed legislation.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  Reports

11A.  Report from City Manager/Executive Director

  A report was given by Art Gallucci, City Manager/Executive Director.

11B.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports

  Reports were given by Councilmembers Barrows and Yokoyama and Mayor Hu.

12.  Closed Session

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, announced the City Council would not recess to Closed
  Session to discuss the following items as listed on the Closed Session agenda:

  12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

  12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk/Treasurer
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, August 26, 2021, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 7 of 7

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 9:03 p.m.
